items.title: The Quiet End Of Quadjet Long-Haul Flights At Europe's Most Iconic Flag Carrier
items.summary: SWISS will retire its last A340s by 2027. The final aircraft will become a museum exhibit in Lucerne alongside a Swissair Convair 990.

items.title: Over 10 737 MAX & A320neo Jets Set For Teardown This Year As Parts Demand Soars
items.summary: A mix of Airbus A320neo and Boeing 737 MAX aircraft are destined for teardown before the end of the year, as the demand for aircraft parts continues to rise. This will see more than ten A320neo and MAX aircraft destined for dismantling, as Tarmac Aerosave continues to process aircraft for recycling for its long-term client AerFin.
